detail: Harness ~/code/twining-benchmark-harness HEAD 279edb6: agent sessions run via @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk query() (Max login works); the evaluator client is constructed only when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set (src/runner/orchestrator.ts:164-169). Conditions pin the server via TWINING_MCP_SPEC and the plugin via TWINING_PLUGIN_PATH / ~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json. The nearest analogue of the package's "native memory plus journals/handoffs" arm is shared-markdown. Oracles supply dev variants for C01–C09 and held-out variants for C01–C08 (17 total). A detached built worktree of foundation/v3 HEAD at .claude/worktrees/v3-trial serves the v3 arm (A11); note its package.json still says 2.16.1 (RB7's 3.0.0-alpha.N stamp was never applied; `npm version` rebuilds and stages the plugin bundle, so it is coupled to the owner's plugin release) — trial metadata must identify arms by commit/spec, not by reported version. Decisions D45–D48 in the programme log; workflow trial-understand-design writes docs/plans/2026-09-16-dev-scale-trial-design.md.
summary: Dev-scale trial constraints: no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (harness judge unavailable, score deterministically); no native-journals condition; 2 oracle variants per case; Max usage shared with this session
